also: what is it? out with it!

terms.gloss: out with it! tell me! give it here!
terms.grammar: old imperative (plural cette), with or without an object
evidence: Plaut. Most. 1.3.150: cedo aquam manibus (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From -ce and the root of dō: “here with it!”, of a thing or of words. Short e, unlike cēdō, go.
